ev_0005.summary: Cyclic quadrilateral ABCD inscribed in circle_01 (center point_05 at (224.29,201.88), r=157.28, full 360 deg visible). Printed letters A, B, C, D bind to point_02, point_01, point_03, point_04 (all on circle). Straight strokes: AB (solid, horizontal, a diameter through center point_05), AD, DC (horizontal top chord), CB. All strokes solid; no dashed segments. No right-angle marks detected. Center point_05 is unlabeled in the figure.

payload.notes: Circle centre (unlabelled, point_05) defined as a helper in the program's frame: x=(224.29-225.5)*0.021333≈-0.026, y=(194-201.88)*0.021333≈-0.168; radius 157.28 px → 3.355 units. Consistent with the program-owned A/B midpoint (≈-0.026). A, B, C, D are used by name only, not redefined. Edges AB, AD, DC, CB are solid, drawn between named coordinates. Circle drawn at 0.8pt (thinner than the 1.2pt edges) to match the "thin curve" request; all edges use the metric 1.2pt with round joins. Labels use the metric 17.5/21 pt font, placed below-left (A), below-right (B), above-right (C), above-left (D), all outside the circle and clear of strokes. No right-angle marks, no extra labels. Note for remeasurement: the program-owned A y-value (-0.156) differs slightly from the centre-derived horizontal diameter (-0.168 at centre); this is within ~0.2 px-equivalent and was left unchanged.

params.instruction: Reconstruct the figure as TikZ using the measured pixel coordinates (flip y: TikZ y = (388 - y_px) scaled consistently). Draw the full circle as a solid thin curve. Solid edges: segment AB; segment AD (A to D, endpoints A and D exactly); segment DC (D to C); segment CB (C to B). Labels: A to the lower-left of A, B to the lower-right of B, C above-right of C, D above-left of D, placed outside the circle. Do not add any extra labels or marks. Use one coordinate definition per vertex.
